scope: Static source audit for the frozen v2 report pipeline; this file is not an experiment result and contains no fabricated values. The final supplement command requires plan.json and matches its 166 trial names and plan SHA to summary.json.
main_cohort: 166 real flight slots; offline JSON is joined only after flight completion.
engineering_cohort: 16 independent one-flight engineering slots; never merged into the 166 denominator.

metrics.limit: Not a formal 166-flight overall detector metric; no occluded/multi-target/general-world claim.
Simulation-clock processed FPS and pure inference wall time are distinct; stage2 safety JSON does not currently save these fields.
Frozen visible-surface anchor with ego-only map alignment; not independently calibrated model-center accuracy.

metrics.source: online_state_accuracy_v2.frames.jsonl intersected with follow_dynamics.windows short request/response window
metrics.limit: TargetState header simulation time and shutter request/response window are not a rendered visibility label; missing reference remains missing.
Settling is conditional on observed final in-band suffix; right-censored and missing windows are not zero. Moving-target transient is not a stationary step response.
Task means are summarized by flight; UNKNOWN/NOT_OBSERVED remain in opportunity denominators. Stage3 formal 40 flights are single-target active/midpoint pairs, not multi-target ReID repeats.
This confirms a newly requested UUID after explicit selection; complete appearance-based ReID after leaving view is out of scope and has no valid metric.

known_gaps: The 16 engineering flight runner records schema-3 safety evaluation but does not automatically create online_state_accuracy_v2.json or follow_dynamics.json; run_full_plan_supplement.py can add those reports later from existing bags without overwriting evidence.
The existing static detector review uses historical eligible rendered frames and cannot be relabeled as the formal 166-flight detector accuracy.
No metric in this audit is a real-aircraft or wall-clock real-time claim.
